Name: Leveling Adjustment
Author: jahangmar
Description:
[size=4][b]What it does:[/b][/size]
In the config.json (generated after first start) you can set a general factor for all skills or a skill factor for each skill. The new gained experience is calculated as follows:
[code]modified_exp = normal_exp * generalExperienceFactor * <skill>ExperienceFactor[/code] where [code]<skill>[/code] is one of the 5 skills.

Example: If you want to level half as fast as normal set the general factor to 0.5. If you want to level the farming skill twice as fast set farmingExperienceFactor to 2.
You can set [font=Courier New]expNotification[/font] to true if you want the mod to display how much exp you gain for each action.
You can set [font=Courier New]levelNotification[/font] to true if you want to get a notification for each level up.

[size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][size=4][b]
Uninstall[/b][/size][size=4][b]:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Remove the folder of this mod.
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility:[/b][/size] [list]
[*]Tested with Stardew Valley 1.4 on Linux.
[*]Not tested in Multiplayer.
[/list]
